def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Marker(s) indicate the pixel color to apply to every occurrence of the marker's
    # surrounding rectangular tile motif. The colored marks sit inside solid 1 rectangles;
    # infer dimensions as the maximal contiguous 1 rectangle surrounding marker.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            k=grid[r][c]
            if k in (0,1): continue
            # determine rectangle bounds by contiguous runs of nonzero cells through marker
            top=r
            while top>0 and grid[top-1][c] != 0: top-=1
            bot=r
            while bot+1<h and grid[bot+1][c] != 0: bot+=1
            left=c
            while left>0 and grid[r][left-1] != 0: left-=1
            right=c
            while right+1<w and grid[r][right+1] != 0: right+=1
            # fill marker's exact block dimensions in all locations where all cells are 1
            bh, bw=bot-top+1,right-left+1
            for y in range(h-bh+1):
                for x in range(w-bw+1):
                    if all(grid[i][j]==1 for i in range(y,y+bh) for j in range(x,x+bw)):
                        for i in range(y,y+bh):
                            for j in range(x,x+bw): out[i][j]=k
    return out
PY
